title: K1605 Phase-2 formal: bank M/B->RV DM test + block bootstrap + filing-lag robustness + semivol

claude_followup.brief: Interpret K1605 formal results: does the M/B-augmented RV forecast beat RV-only baseline under DM |t|>3 (Harvey small-sample)? Do block-bootstrap CIs on the Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional means exclude 0? Is the signal robust across 45/60/90d filing lags and for downside semivol? CRITICAL honesty check: even if DM-significant, the price/value confound (K1605 Phase-1 caveat) means this is NOT isolated fundamental info unless a value/momentum control is added. Update knowledge K1605 accordingly (upgrade to PASS only if DM|t|>3 AND confound addressed; else keep CONDITIONAL/downgrade to NULL).
